title: F-22 Raptor vs F-35 Lightning II
shortAnswer: The F-22 Raptor is the world's premier air superiority fighter with unmatched speed, altitude, and dogfighting capability. The F-35 is a multi-role stealth fighter optimized for strike, ISR, and network warfare. The F-22 wins the air fight; the F-35 wins everything else.
verdict: Different jets for different missions. F-22 for air dominance, F-35 for multi-role flexibility. The F-35's sensor fusion and versatility make it the future, while the F-22 remains unbeatable in a dogfight.

imageB.credit: U.S. Air Force photo by Master Sgt. Donald R. Allen

lines.hook: America built 187 Raptors and then stopped. It's built over a thousand F-35s.
lines.tape: One jet owns the sky. The other owns the war around it.
rounds: Mach 2.25 versus Mach 1.6. The Raptor runs away from fights it doesn't want.
The F-22 cruises past the sound barrier without afterburner. The F-35 can't do it at all.
The F-35 doesn't just see more, it hands you the picture already solved.
187 Raptors means a jet that mostly can't be everywhere. A thousand F-35s can.
Eighty million buys one F-35. The same money nearly buys you half a Raptor.
lines.verdict: F-35 takes it three to two. Pick the Raptor only if the mission is pure air dominance.

youtubeTitle: F-22 Raptor vs F-35 Lightning II: Which Jet Actually Wins?
youtubeDescription:
Head to head on speed, supercruise, sensor fusion, production numbers and unit cost, the F-22 Raptor and F-35 Lightning II split the scorecard three to two. The Raptor hits Mach 2.25 and supercruises at Mach 1.5, but only 187 were ever built at over 150 million each. The F-35 counters with best in class sensor fusion, more than a thousand airframes and an 80 million dollar price tag.

Figures accurate as of October 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/f-22-vs-f-35
